subject: Investigation: ElevateFin v8a P95 drift — request for provisional SLA carveout and rollback trigger
messages:
From: Sarah Meyers <sarah@elevatefin.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@elevatefin.com
Date: Wed, 29 May 2029 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Elevated P95 after v8a switch — urgent

Ben,

We flipped to v8a last night and since ~00:40 UTC we've seen a sustained P95 increase from 220ms to ~420ms for the high-frequency endpoints. This is impacting our customer-facing search bar (timeout errors up ~1.8%). Tagging ops for logs. Can you confirm if Redwood has a known regression on v8a?

We need either a rollback to v7k or an immediate mitigation window; our SRE team is holding traffic if this continues. Please advise next steps and expected timeline.

— Sarah
Sarah Meyers
Head of Platform | ElevateFin
[sarah@elevatefin.com]

Attachments: p95-timeseries-20290529.csv (CSV), service-snippet.log (text stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Meyers <sarah@elevatefin.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 29 May 2029 16:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Elevated P95 after v8a switch — urgent

Sarah — thanks for flagging and for the CSV. Sorry for the trouble. I'm escalating immediately.

Immediate plan:
- I've looped in Karthik (serving/runtime) and Marissa (acct lead) to evaluate rollback authorization.
- Karthik will request telemetry + kernel selection trace from infra and confirm if it's a quantization/kernel mismatch.
- If we confirm a v8a-specific regression, we will request a provisional SLA carveout for the window and propose a rollback to v7k with a target = 45 minutes for traffic shift.

Can you confirm current % traffic on v8a and whether you want a hard rollback (all traffic) vs staged canary? If ops has already pinned traffic, call that out.

I will follow up within 15 minutes with a status update.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: None

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Sarah Meyers <sarah@elevatefin.com>
Date: Wed, 29 May 2029 16:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Elevated P95 after v8a switch — urgent

Ben/Marissa — quick technical notes from the runtime team after a first-pass analysis of the logs Sarah attached:

Observations:
- The regression surfaces on sequences > 128 tokens and primarily on the `search` endpoint where we apply response truncation.
- Kernel selection shows a fallback to a slower attention path for v8a on nodes with Ampere T4-equivalent instances — likely due to a new fused-kernel selector that misclassifies the model as unsupported for the optimized path.
- No evidence of increased token counts or external network congestion. KV cache hit rates unchanged.

Risk assessment and options:
1) Rollback to v7k (safe, immediate). Traffic shift estimate: ~30–50 minutes to fully complete with a staged canary at 10% -> 50% -> 100%.
2) Emergency kernel patch (fast-path fix) — estimated 2–4 hours including validation; risk: potential additional regressions on other customers if we push without canary.
3) Provisional SLA carveout (request to approve temporary P95 > SLA while we remediate) — reduces commercial risk for ElevateFin but needs leadership approval.

Requesting the following from Sales/Acct:
- Marissa: approve carveout language and communicate commercial stance (credits/waiver).
- Ben: confirm customer preference for rollback vs carveout.
- Laura: if legal/enterprise terms require a formal authorization email for rollback, can you prepare a one-line approval template we can use?

I'll prepare a short telemetry pack (p95 trend, kernel traces) and upload to the Drive link.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Meyers <sarah@elevatefin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 30 May 2029 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Elevated P95 after v8a switch — urgent

Sarah — update and recommended path forward.

Summary:
- Karthik's team identified a kernel selector regression affecting v8a on certain instance classes which is the likely cause of the 200ms P95 increase.
- Two remediation paths: rollback to v7k (fast) or emergency kernel patch (longer).

Customer ask received: you prefer a full rollback to v7k to restore P95 immediately. We will prioritize that.

Actions we will take now (authorization request):
1) We will initiate a staged rollback 10% -> 50% -> 100% across your production region; estimated completion 35–50 minutes.
2) We request provisional SLA carveout for the affected window (2029-05-30T03:30:00Z to 2029-05-30T04:30:00Z) while we validate post-rollback telemetry. This will be recorded against the deal and used for any credits calculation, pending Marissa/legal confirmation.
3) Karthik will run the rollback and monitor P95 and error-rate metrics; he'll post final telemetry and confirm success.

Please reply with a one-line authorization that you approve the rollback and carveout (e.g., "ElevateFin authorizes Redwood to rollback to v7k and approves provisional SLA carveout for the remediation window"). Once we have that, Laura will produce a brief authorization record for our logs and Marissa will follow up on commercial steps.

Apologies again — we aim to restore your SLA quickly.

— Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

body_summary: Customer reported P95 regression after model switch to v8a. Internal runtime analysis found a kernel selector fallback causing slower path on certain instance types. Team recommended rollback to v7k; customer authorized rollback and provisional SLA carveout. Rollback planned staged; telemetry and authorization artifacts to be recorded.
